items.text: Perform the ancestral sacrifices in the temple of the former kings with the appointed instruments.
items.quote: These they employed at the sacrifices in the temple of the former kings
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with Exodus 20:3-5; honor the dead but do not offer sacrifices to them.

items.text: In the temple services, take your place according to rank and age, giving honor to those above you.
items.quote: in arranging the services of officers (in the temple) according to the rank due to each, as noble or mean

heading: Liji 17 · Yue Ji 樂記 · Record Of Music · Yue Ji III.20 … Yue Ji III.28

items.text: Be filial to your parents, honoring and serving them as the people learned from the king's example.
items.quote: He offered sacrifice in the Hall of Distinction, and the people learned to be filial.

items.text: Honor and defer to elder siblings as the king deferred to the aged, fulfilling brotherly duties.
items.quote: he taught the lords their brotherly duties.

items.text: In family gatherings, listen together to music so that harmony and affection prevail among fathers, sons, brothers, and cousins.
items.quote: Within the gate of the family, fathers and sons, brothers and cousins, listen together to it, and all is harmony and affection.

heading: Liji 17 · Yue Ji 樂記 · Record Of Music · Yue Ji III.3 … Yue Ji III.13

items.text: Preserve the proper distinction between father and son: do not mix or treat each other as equals.
items.quote: there is no distinction between father and son

items.text: Fulfill your duties as a father to your son, as the sages established for the guidance of society.
items.quote: set forth the duties between father and son

items.text: Fulfill your duties as a son to your father, as the sages established for the guidance of society.
items.quote: set forth the duties between father and son

items.text: At ancestral sacrifices, use only solemn and harmonious music, not the corrupt airs of Zheng, Song, Wei, or Qi.
items.quote: In solemn unison (the instruments) give forth their notes; Our ancestors will hearken to them.

heading: Liji 17 · Yue Ji 樂記 · Record Of Music · Yue Ji I.13 … Yue Ji I.25

items.text: Mourn your deceased parents with sackcloth, wailing, and weeping as the mourning rites define.
items.quote: By the sackcloth worn for parents, the wailings, and the weepings, they defined the terms of the mourning rites.

items.text: Perform the capping ceremony for your son and the hair-pin ceremony for your daughter to mark their adulthood and maintain the separation of male and female.
items.quote: By marriage, capping, and the assumption of the hair-pin, they maintained the separation that should exist between male and female.

items.text: Show affection to your son, and secure his affection in return.
Love your father with affection, as he loves you.
Maintain the orderly relation with those of the younger generation by treating them with kindness and care.
items.quote: orderly relation between old and young

items.text: Respect those of the elder generation and maintain the orderly relation with them.
items.quote: orderly relation between old and young

items.text: Offer sacrifices to ancestors in the ancestral temple, using music and ceremony.
items.quote: the use of them in the ancestral temple
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; honor parents but worship God alone.
